picks.reasoning: LCP's 33% international rate edges LCS's 29%, but that's 3-6 against 4-10, which is noise, and the house rule doesn't give me a real signal there. Josedeodo's 7.6 KDA against POUT's 4.4, plus TLAW's +1.1k at 15 over the last 20 against CFO's -0.2k, says the stronger players and the better form are on the LCS side.

Tempo belongs to TLAW: +1.1k at 15, 75% first towers, 65% first dragons, and CFO sits at -0.2k with only 35% dragon control. Region strength is close to a coin flip, since LCP's 33% against other regions edges LCS's 29%, but LCS took the head-to-head, so I'm keeping my edge small.

On paper TLAW's draft depth and form look cleaner, but LCP holds the stronger international record (3-6, 33% against other regions versus LCS's 4-10, 29%), so region strength decides this one. I'm taking CFO's Naafiri/Lulu-Milio draft shell and the region edge, with the win probability kept close to a coin flip.

Internationally LCP has the slightly better 2026 rate (3-6, 33%) than LCS (4-10, 29%), and the region rule weighs that heavily, outweighing TLAW's better GD@15, objective and dragon numbers. The edge is thin, so I'm only leaning CFO.

Vibes and form lean toward TLAW, with their LCS title and a steady mood, but LCP holds the slightly better international record (33% vs 29%) and the house rule says to weight that heavily. CFO's two blown leads worry me about their nerve, so I'm holding this one loosely.
